description: SVG assets cropped and organized from Birthday Moments reference asset sheets. All assets are original vector artwork inspired by the reference sheets, using the midnight-plum, lavender, coral, and warm-ivory visual identity.
license: Reference assets may be similar to other outputs; review before commercial release. See README.txt for details.

birthday-cake-3d.svg.description: 3-tier birthday cake with candles, berries, and heart decoration. Visual reference for Three.js 3D cake implementation.

sealed-envelope.svg.description: Sealed lavender envelope with coral heart wax seal. Used in the envelope-opening experience.

open-envelope.svg.description: Open envelope revealing letter paper inside. Used in animated letter opening.

love-letter.svg.description: Decorative birthday letter with floral border corners and heart seal.

gift-box.svg.description: Purple gift box with coral ribbon bow and star decorations.

balloon-bunch.svg.description: Bunch of four colorful balloons (pink, purple, gold, lavender) with strings and bow.

bouquet.svg.description: Flower bouquet with pink and purple blooms, green stems and leaves, wrapped in coral paper.

floating-hearts.svg.description: Collection of floating hearts in coral, purple, and pink of various sizes.

storybook-open.svg.description: Open storybook with castle illustration, moon, stars, and lined pages.

polaroid-frame.svg.description: Polaroid-style photo frame with heart decoration, for memory gallery display.

stars-sparkles.svg.description: Decorative gold, purple, and coral stars with sparkle dots.

crescent-moon.svg.description: Golden crescent moon with surrounding stars for night-time decoration.

confetti-cannon.svg.description: Party confetti cannon with streamers and confetti pieces for celebration moments.

implementationNotes: All assets are SVG for infinite scalability and small file size.
The cake SVG is a visual reference only - the actual interactive 3D cake is implemented in Three.js (see src/components/birthday-assets/ThreeDCake.tsx).
Interactive controls (buttons, toggles) are built with HTML/CSS/SVG per requirements - not using images as buttons.
Assets use the project color palette: midnight-plum, lavender, coral, warm-ivory.
Lazy-load non-critical assets using loading='lazy' on  tags.
